Sofia — really helpful dataset, thank you. Looping in Jasmine (solutions engineering) to cover the technical knobs and Neha for commercial/credits. Quick answers up top, details below: 

TL;DR
- Pilot shape (50M tokens/month): we typically recommend a blended pilot credit of 2–3k USD/month per 10M tokens baked into a time-boxed pilot — we can make this more favorable if you commit to a short Dedicated evaluation.
- Quantization: start 8-bit dynamic/FP8-style inference paths for accuracy-sensitive NLU; evaluate 4-bit for low-cost batch paths once you have representative evals.
- Caching: prefix/KV caching reduces per-token compute significantly for repeated retrieval-style prompts; we recommend a 2-stage cache — short-prefix caching at the gateway + model KV cache retention configured to your session lengths.

Hi Sofia — quick technical notes and a proposed test plan; I’ve inline-referenced your prompt set. 

1) Profiling
- Step 1 (1 day): run 2000 representative requests through Optimize profiling endpoint (we can provide a signed upload script). Capture tokens/request, 95th% latency, and model variant.
- Step 2 (2–3 days): run 8-bit vs 4-bit inference on a 1k-sample slice (we’ll perform QAT where necessary). Expect ~5–8% quality drop on 4-bit for rare-entity extraction; 8-bit is generally a safe first pass.

2) Caching strategy
- Gateway prefix cache: dedupe identical retrieval prompts and normalize the preface (we saw 20–40% effective token reduction when clients normalized retrieval context).
- KV cache: set retention to match median session length (your workbook shows sessions ~12–15 turns; 30s–2m retention is a reasonable starting point).

3) Batching guidance
- Real-time chat: conservative batching (10–40ms windows) to preserve latency SLOs; aggregate small bursts into micro-batches.
- Bulk rerank/embedding flows: run larger batches during off-peak to reduce unit cost.

I’ll spin up a short lab run if you approve — we can produce a one-page quantization delta report.

Daniel / Sofia — appreciate the edits. Proposed commercial and next steps below (I also populated a draft MAP at the link).

Commercial proposal (pilot)- Pilot length: 6 weeks
- Credits: $12,000 total applied to usage during pilot (covers ~50M blended tokens in Optimize with caching in place)
- Success triggers: 1) p95 latency <200ms with gateway batching windows <=40ms for chat; 2) F1 drop vs baseline <=3% on the supplied prompt set; 3) KV cache hit rate >=35% on repeated retrieval prompts
- Conversion: if success triggers are met, Nebula may elect to convert to a 6-month reserved Dedicated evaluation with a committed monthly token band; conversion incentive: first-month fee waived and additional 10% commit discount for first 3 months.

Technical notes- SLA: there is no functional accuracy SLA for quantization; for Dedicated pools we guarantee latency SLOs per the Dedicated contract (we’ll include a clause about fallback to a higher-precision variant if accuracy regresses beyond the 3% threshold).
- Quantization path: start with 8-bit in hosted Optimize; if you want Dedicated cost parity, we can validate 4-bit batch paths during the pilot but we treat that as a technical runbook item, not a guaranteed outcome.

Next steps
1) Sofia: confirm acceptance and we’ll send a formal MAP (Docx + link).
2) Nebula infra: run profiling script (Jasmine will share) and upload the 2k sample.
3) Neha and I will submit a one-time pilot credit PO and legal sign-off for the MAP.

Link to draft MAP: https://app.redwood.com/ma-plans/DL-2026-0091

If that all sounds good I’ll kick procurement and legal here and schedule a 30-minute kickoff next week.
